name: Biting the Hand
summary: Fuzzle asks you to leave with him and promises a reward once you are safe. He snarls as any would-be pursuers are threatened.

sections.title: Leaving with Fuzzle
sections.body: Fuzzle is ready to leave, and he asks you to go with him. He warns that anyone who tries to stop you will be torn to shreds. Your safety comes first; he promises a reward once you are clear.

faq.q: Who is asking me to leave?
faq.answer: Fuzzle asks you to leave with him.
Fuzzle threatens to tear apart anyone who tries to stop you.

faq.q: When will Fuzzle give me a reward?
faq.answer: Fuzzle says he will give you a reward once you are safe.
Fuzzle has amassed a hefty sum of gold, which becomes yours.

attribution: In-game quest text: Biting the Hand
